verdict.rationale: Fee transparency is a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers rate structures, alternative fee arrangements or billing practices. The pages describe practice areas, deal volume, awards and offices only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm states publicly how engagements are priced — rate structures, alternative fee arrangements, or billing practices — rather than leaving cost entirely opaque
